name: Spoonacular
tagline: Food and recipe API with nutrition data, meal planning, and grocery product info
description: Spoonacular is a food data API offering recipes, ingredients, nutrition analysis, meal planning, grocery products, menu items, and wine pairings. Developers authenticate with an API key and call REST endpoints for search, similar recipes, convert amounts, compute nutrition, and generate meal plans. It is widely used in cooking apps, diet trackers, and grocery tools.

auth.details: API key via query param apiKey= or x-api-key header; self-serve signup at spoonacular.com/food-api

use_cases: search recipes by ingredients or diet
get nutrition facts for a recipe or ingredient
generate a meal plan for a day or week
find similar recipes to a given dish
look up grocery product information by UPC
analyze a recipe's nutrition from free text
